# Sustainable Oakington and Westwick RSS capture

`feed.xml` is a reduced fixture from the public, robots-permitted publisher feed
captured on November 22, 2026. `manifest.json` records its URL, original byte
length, item count and SHA-256 hash. No publisher requests run in these tests.

The fixture retains all ten post identities, canonical links, publication dates,
article titles, event headings and factual schedule contexts. Full `content:encoded`
articles are represented, not the short RSS excerpts. It preserves the repeated
October 22/November 6 wreath announcements, old November events, explicit
next-year Repair Cafe reminder, order deadline and older section shapes.

Images, EXIF, tracking, author metadata and long article narratives are omitted.
Synthetic supporting prose is labelled; the donation/all-ages facts are
paraphrased. The full original capture is not committed.

The publisher currently supplies ten complete recent articles. This fixture is
a rolling-feed snapshot, not an exhaustive historical archive. A changed item
count, missing full content or explicit pagination holds collection for review.
Generic posts, deadlines, services and explicitly unscheduled notices do not
become events. Tests introduce new future titles/dates and the observed heading
and paragraph shapes to prove extraction is not fixed to one article or workshop.
